checks: D3D8/9 two-word status defaults, exact Set/Get and software fixed-function PV/ordinary/indexed/UP processing use common C code
software status processes the entire declared index range, including unreferenced vertices; validates referenced indices, complete source ranges and bone indices before modifying accumulated bits
legacy Get reports EXTENTS2 and preserves caller Z words; Set updates only flagged fields and rejects EXTENTS3 with the measured HRESULT
D3D7 CLIP operation accumulates OR/AND while EXTENTS updates viewport-clamped screen bounds with the measured one-pixel margin; native high status bits are preserved
ordinary untransformed VB draws process status, while pretransformed buffer draws do not repeat processing
immediate pretransformed status is generated only with clipping enabled, ignores world user planes and uses physical [0,1] screen depth independently of viewport MinZ/MaxZ
one shared unprojection formula serves processed draw geometry and immediate screen-space status

D3D9 POSITIONT bypasses a bound vertex shader; unsupported CPU vertex programs/layouts leave rendering on its existing GPU path and refuse stale status queries until an explicit reset or disabled processing clears history
DrawRectPatch and DrawTriPatch do not update status; ordinary N-patch and public indexed-UP paths retain their own behavior
all three frontends run in one XP boot for both status and separately recorded real draw calls; each process has a distinct fully released owner
published latest traces include compiled DLL/executable/source provenance and strip desktop/cursor pixels and diagnostic strings
pre-existing numeric fixture cases remain unchanged; only source hashes refreshed
clip mutation tests isolate each mutated header/source in a separate directory to avoid one mutant influencing another
